purpose: 完整读取固定十三旧用途原件及全部已有当前报告/发布正文，保持共享版本失败
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
import json, hashlib, re
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

root=Path.cwd()
out=root/'reports/research/510300_bank_excess_reserve_buffer_source_qualification_v1'
old=root/'reports/research/510300_corporate_loan_weighted_rate_source_qualification_v1'
legacy=root/'reports/research/510300_historical_index_liquidity_transmission_v1'
now=lambda: datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat()
def readj(p):
    return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def writej(name,obj):
    p=out/name
    if p.exists():
        raise RuntimeError('不覆盖已有研究原件：'+str(p))
    p.write_text(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
def ident(p):
    b=p.read_bytes()
    return {'path':p.relative_to(root).as_posix(),'bytes':len(b),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()}
proto=readj(out/'protocol.json')
prior=[]
for rel in proto['prior_use_first']:
    p=root/rel
    body=p.read_bytes().decode('utf-8-sig')
    hits=[]
    for m in re.finditer(r'超额准备金|超储率|excess[_ -]?reserve',body,re.I):
        hits.append({'position':m.start(),'context':body[max(0,m.start()-140):m.end()+220]})
    prior.append({**ident(p),'full_text_read':True,'all_target_keyword_contexts':hits})
gate=readj(old/'source_gate.json')
writej('实际旧用途与原载体版本依赖.json',{
    'study_id':proto['study_id'],'experiment_id':'E76','completed_at':now(),
    'finite_actual_prior_review':prior,
    'scope':'固定十三文件完整读取，仅对这些实际原件作有限旧用途判断，不宣称全repo不存在旧用途。',
    'same_named_numeric_field_same_conditional_scoring_use_found_in_these_files':False,
    'actual_old_reference':'2018降准机制解释出现超额准备金概念，不是29季公开原比率的同一评分字段。',
    'shared_original_carrier_gate':{**ident(old/'source_gate.json'),'status':gate['status'],'quarters_with_later_file_and_creation_metadata':gate['quarters_with_later_file_and_creation_metadata'],'failure_reason':gate['failure_reason']},
    'decision':'不同经济字段并不修复相同PDF的历史版本与公布钟映射。先核已有原全文及实际发布正文中的目标原数值；原E17终态及其关闭预算保持，不改日期或当前文件元数据营救。',
    'new_stock_labels':0,'new_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'new_network_queries':0,'new_GETs':0,'source_code_edits':0
})
receipts=readj(old/'pdf_receipts.json')
version={r['季度']:r for r in readj(old/'当前PDF与历史公布时钟对齐.json')}
jobs={r['quarter']:r for r in readj(old/'固定16季度PDF取得计划.json')['jobs']}
manifest=readj(legacy/'source_manifest.json')
writej('本地原载体清单结构.json',{'legacy_manifest':manifest,'e17_receipts':receipts,'e17_version_dependency':version})
records={}
allhits=[]
def extract_hits(pages,quarter):
    rows=[]
    for item in pages:
        text=item['text']
        page=item.get('pdf_page_1based',item.get('pdf_page'))
        clean=re.sub(r'\s+','',text).replace('％','%')
        for m in re.finditer(r'超额准备金(?:率)?',clean):
            context=clean[max(0,m.start()-110):m.end()+210]
            ratios=[]
            for n in re.finditer(r'(?:金融机构|银行业金融机构|商业银行)[^。；]{0,32}?超额准备金率(?:为|是)?([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)%',context):
                ratios.append({'institution_and_qualifier':n.group(0).split('超额准备金率')[0],'named_rate_percent':float(n.group(1)),'matched_original_text':n.group(0)})
            rows.append({'quarter':quarter,'pdf_page_1based':page,'context_without_layout_whitespace':context,'named_ratio_candidates':ratios,'current_quarter_assignment':'待按原经济截止逐句确认，历史回述不回填'})
    return rows
for r in receipts:
    q=r['quarter']
    if q=='2025Q4':
        continue
    pdf=root/r['path']
    if ident(pdf)['sha256']!=r['sha256']:
        raise RuntimeError('已有PDF身份不符：'+q)
    cache=old/'extracted_pages'/f'{q}_pages.json'
    pages=readj(cache)
    if len(pages)<1:
        raise RuntimeError('空原全文缓存：'+q)
    hits=extract_hits(pages,q)
    release=root/r['release_page_path']
    html=release.read_bytes().decode('utf-8-sig')
    soup=BeautifulSoup(html,'html.parser')
    node=soup.select_one('#zoom') or soup.select_one('.TRS_Editor') or soup.select_one('.TRS_PreAppend') or soup
    release_text=node.get_text(' ',strip=True)
    rh=[release_text[max(0,m.start()-100):m.end()+180] for m in re.finditer('超额准备金',release_text)]
    records[q]={'quarter':q,'carrier':'E17实际当前原报告缓存','pdf':ident(pdf),'text_cache':ident(cache),'pages_full_text_read':len(pages),'target_hits':hits,
      'original_publication_page':ident(release),'original_publication_display':r['displayed_published_at'],
      'target_scalar_in_release_page_body_contexts':rh,
      'same_carrier_later_file_than_original_release':q in gate['quarters_with_later_file_and_creation_metadata'],
      'current_target_value_to_original_release_clock_admitted':False,
      'clock_limit':'当前PDF目标数值尚未单独绑定历史发布页；同日元数据也不认证首版。','numerator':'UNKNOWN','denominator':'UNKNOWN','actual_ratio_change_cause':'UNKNOWN'}
    allhits.extend(hits)
for q in ['2018Q2','2018Q4','2019Q1','2019Q2','2019Q3']:
    lower=q[:4]+'q'+q[-1]
    pdf=legacy/'sources'/f'pbc_{lower}.pdf'
    cache=legacy/'sources'/f'pbc_{lower}_pages.json'
    pages=readj(cache)
    hits=extract_hits(pages,q)
    records[q]={'quarter':q,'carrier':'2018流动性传导既有当前报告缓存','pdf':ident(pdf),'text_cache':ident(cache),'pages_full_text_read':len(pages),'target_hits':hits,
     'original_publication_page':'UNKNOWN','original_publication_display':'UNKNOWN_UNVERIFIED_OLD_MANIFEST_DATE',
     'target_scalar_in_release_page_body_contexts':[],'same_carrier_later_file_than_original_release':'UNKNOWN',
     'current_target_value_to_original_release_clock_admitted':False,'clock_limit':'旧研究常量日期不是本实验原发布正文或原目标数值版本证明。','numerator':'UNKNOWN','denominator':'UNKNOWN','actual_ratio_change_cause':'UNKNOWN'}
    allhits.extend(hits)
targets=[]
for q0 in proto['target_quarters']:
    q=q0.replace('-','')
    item=records.get(q)
    targets.append(item if item else {'quarter':q,'carrier':'UNKNOWN_NO_LOCAL_ORIGINAL_CURRENT_REPORT','target_hits':[],
        'current_target_value_to_original_release_clock_admitted':False,'numerator':'UNKNOWN','denominator':'UNKNOWN','actual_ratio_change_cause':'UNKNOWN'})
writej('全部本地原报告_超额准备金全部原锚.json',{'study_id':proto['study_id'],'completed_at':now(),
    'target_quarters_29_complete':targets,'prior_definition_anchor_2018Q2_separate':records['2018Q2'],
    'all_named_and_nonrate_target_mentions':allhits,
    'local_current_target_carriers':sum(t['carrier']!='UNKNOWN_NO_LOCAL_ORIGINAL_CURRENT_REPORT' for t in targets),
    'target_quarters_without_local_current_carrier':[t['quarter'] for t in targets if t['carrier']=='UNKNOWN_NO_LOCAL_ORIGINAL_CURRENT_REPORT'],
    'genuine_original_release_body_target_value_found':sum(bool(t.get('target_scalar_in_release_page_body_contexts')) for t in targets),
    'minimum_full_29_source_gate_passed':False,'model_registration':'NOT_REGISTERED','new_stock_labels':0,'new_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'new_queries':0,'new_GETs':0,'source_code_edits':0})
print('固定旧用途资格已保存：13原件完整读取，未发现该原比率同一评分用途；共享E17版本失败保持。')
print('原29目标全部保留；本地原载体',sum(t['carrier']!='UNKNOWN_NO_LOCAL_ORIGINAL_CURRENT_REPORT' for t in targets),'缺失',sum(t['carrier']=='UNKNOWN_NO_LOCAL_ORIGINAL_CURRENT_REPORT' for t in targets))
for t in targets:
    print(t['quarter'],'原锚',len(t['target_hits']),'版本较晚',t.get('same_carrier_later_file_than_original_release'),'发布正文目标锚',len(t.get('target_scalar_in_release_page_body_contexts',[])))
    for h in t['target_hits']:
        if h['named_ratio_candidates']:
            print('页',h['pdf_page_1based'],h['context_without_layout_whitespace'])
print('2018Q2定义原锚单列',len(records['2018Q2']['target_hits']),'新标签/拟合/账户/网络/源码均0')
